args.sql_query:
SELECT
    AVG(CAST(days_supply AS FLOAT64)) AS mean_days_supply,
    STDDEV(CAST(days_supply AS FLOAT64)) AS stddev_days_supply,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(CAST(days_supply AS FLOAT64), 100)[OFFSET(25)] AS p25_days_supply,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(CAST(days_supply AS FLOAT64), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_days_supply,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(CAST(days_supply AS FLOAT64), 100)[OFFSET(75)] AS p75_days_supply
FROM
    drug_exposure
WHERE
    days_supply IS NOT NULL
